title: Shisha Cloudz – Ice Lemon 100ml
description:
Shisha Cloudz – Ice Lemon 100ml
Ice Lemon by Shisha Cloudz e-liquids is an original icy citrus shisha flavour.
Ice lemon is filled with the refreshment of lemon and ice that will be your perfect all-day-vape juice.
Shisha Cloudz e-juices come with 0mg nicotine level and a 70VG/30PG ratio.
